purpose: An AI assistant that answers questions about procurement of spare parts from a set of documents, including finding parts, calculating prices, lead times, and minimum order quantities, and providing explanations of supplier terms and procurement approval rules.
scope: The assistant will cover the procurement of spare parts for Seaview Shipping Ltd, including finding parts by part number or description, calculating prices and lead times, and providing explanations of supplier terms and procurement approval rules.
brief: I need an assistant for our ship-spares procurement team. It should find spare parts by part number or description, give prices, suppliers, lead times and minimum order quantities, calculate order totals and discounts, and explain supplier terms and our procurement approval rules.
